A Storied Life: Tabitha.title: A Storied Life: Tabitha
A Storied Life: Tabitha.summary: A wholesome narrative puzzle game about the objects we leave behind and the stories they tell. Complete a loved one's damaged memoirs by exploring their home and packing away their things.

Agent 64: Spies Never Die.title: Agent 64: Spies Never Die
Agent 64: Spies Never Die.summary: Relive the golden era of gaming with a retro FPS that captures the essence of 90s console shooters. Embark on a thrilling journey of espionage and action, tackling various objectives while battling cutting-edge 64bit powered enemy AI. Enter a world where bullets and secrets collide!

Angels Fall First (video game).title: Angels Fall First
Angels Fall First (video game).summary:
Angels Fall First is a first person combined-arms sci-fi wargame.
From commanding the battle standing on the bridge of your flagship all the way down to frantic infantry firefights - AFF brings together all the combat you ever wanted.
Featuring tactical team-oriented gameplay and offering a wide selection of weapons, tools, vehicles and spacecraft, AFF focuses on objective-based scenarios with a high degree of replayability, playable both online and offline.

Barbie: Horse Ride & Rescue.title: Barbie: Horse Ride & Rescue
Barbie: Horse Ride & Rescue.summary: Start your Western horse riding adventure with Barbie at Roaming Hearts Rescue Ranch. Rescue and rehabilitate charming horses, test your riding skills and customize your style as you uncover the mysteries of Moonrise Valley!

Beastro (video game).title: Beastro
Beastro (video game).summary: Welcome to Beastro! In this charming fusion of fantasy adventure, not all heroes wield swords… Some prefer the spoon. And, sometimes to save the world you’ve got to start with a really good meal.

Become (video game).title: Become
Become (video game).summary: Experience life's fantastical journey as one of millions of sperm. Survive the microcosm dangers, wiggle, dash and compete through the human reproductive system and create new life.

Bus Simulator 27.title: Bus Simulator 27
Bus Simulator 27.summary: Get ready for Bus Simulator 27, the most advanced entry in the history of the franchise. Look forward to our most comprehensive bus fleet yet, with new officially licensed brands and bus models, as well as iconic buses from the series.

Casualties: Unknown.title: Casualties: Unknown
Casualties: Unknown.summary: Casualties: Unknown is an unforgiving cave-exploration survival simulator. Your captors have tasked you with retrieving lost cargo on a foreign planet, explore its 5 layers and do your best to survive diverse hostile environments. You are just one of the thousands of test subjects sent to die.

Corpse Party II: Darkness Distortion.title: Corpse Party II: Darkness Distortion
Corpse Party II: Darkness Distortion.publisher: MAGES., Marvelous Europe Ltd., XSEED Games
Corpse Party II: Darkness Distortion.summary: Corpse Party II: Darkness Distortion follows three high school friends; Haruka Nanami, Nemu Takanashi, and Maria Hitsugi, as they explore the Amare Est Vivere Hospital, testing a local urban legend as the streamer Nemu seeks to boost her subscriber count. Unfortunately for the three girls, the legend of “Ayame’s Mercy” is true, and they trigger a decades-old curse that sends them into a dark realm. Together they must avoid the vengeful spirit of Ayame Kirishima and other horrors from the hospital’s dark past as they search for a way to dispel Ayame’s curse once and for all.

Creepshow (video game).title: Creepshow
Creepshow (video game).summary: Get lost in a deliciously dark horror anthology. Inspired by Shudder’s Creepshow series, this point-and-click adventure has gone all kinds of wrong.

Dreadline Express.title: Dreadline Express
Dreadline Express.summary:
Investigative odyssey into the minds of fading passengers facing the end of the world aboard the last human train.

An adventure game that doesn't set specific goals. It naturally encourages you to make your own decisions and draw your own conclusions, providing a highly immersive experience with a fair amount of story branching.

Endacopia.title: Endacopia
Endacopia.summary: Endacopia is a nontraditional point-and-click adventure game. Guide a lost child named Mellow through a world governed by unfamiliar rules. Relying on his strong gut instinct and your guidance as his guardian angel, Mellow must overcome obstacles in search of a place to call home.

FIFA Heroes.title: FIFA Heroes
FIFA Heroes.summary: FIFA Heroes game will bring together FIFA's official mascots and recognizable fictional characters alongside football's biggest icons. This is arcade football reimagined with matches that are quick, explosive and full of surprises. Players will be able to master superpowers such as teleport dribble, flaming power shot, or magnetic tackle to turn matches upside down. Build your squad, master their skills, and dominate the competition in a brand-new way to play the world's favourite sport. Solace partnered with leading NYC game studio Enver to publish and develop FIFA Heroes. Founded in 2021 and based in New York City, Enver is a media-first gaming company creating culture-shaping worlds.

Fields of Mistria.title: Fields of Mistria
Fields of Mistria.summary: Start your new life! Build the farm of your dreams as you discover a world brimming with possibilities. Magic, romance, and adventure all await you in this nostalgic farming / life sim RPG!

Forbidden Solitaire.title: Forbidden Solitaire
Forbidden Solitaire.publisher: Grey Alien Games, Night Signal Entertainment
Forbidden Solitaire.summary: Forbidden Solitaire is a card-slashing horror game about unearthing the contents of a cryptic 1995 CD-ROM that should have never existed. From the creators of Ancient Enemy and Home Safety Hotline.

Funi Raccoon Game.title: Funi Raccoon Game
Funi Raccoon Game.summary: Explore a series of whimsical, interconnected worlds to steal everything not nailed down. Make a garbage bin a garbage home :)

Gaelic Football Laochra.title: Gaelic Football Laochra
Gaelic Football Laochra.summary: Feel the intensity of Gaelic Football Laochra! From heated county showdowns to the pinnacle of the Irish Championship, every game delivers authentic gameplay, strategic depth, and electrifying action. Every clash is a test of skill, and every triumph brings you closer to glory!

Garfield: Escape from Monday.title: Garfield: Escape from Monday
Garfield: Escape from Monday.summary: Wake up Garfield from this nightmarish veggie filled 3D Platformer! The laziest cat is about to work hard in Garfield - Escape from Monday!

Glaciered.title: Glaciered
Glaciered.summary: Glaciered is an action-adventure indie game that takes place on a glacier-covered Earth 65 million years in the future. Play as a Tuai, a species evolved from birds, to soar through the seas and fight against the threats to this new golden age of life.

Going Medieval.title: Going Medieval
Going Medieval.summary: Build and manage your own castle settlement in a land reclaimed by wilderness. With detailed management, survival strategy, and a moddable sandbox world, Going Medieval challenges you to build the mightiest colony this side of the apocalypse.

Golf With Your Friends 2.title: Golf With Your Friends 2
Golf With Your Friends 2.summary: Tee off in Golf With Your Friends 2! Dive into 12-player chaos, wild new course mechanics, a revamped level editor, and nonstop fun—play together no matter how and where your friends play!

GreedFall: The Dying World.title: GreedFall: The Dying World
GreedFall: The Dying World.summary:
The story starts three years before the events of the first game and the adventures of De Sardet.

This time you play as a native of Teer Fradee, uprooted by force from your island and taken to the continent of Gacane, where the colonists are from. In this old world ravaged by war and scarred by the Malichor plague and the political scheming of the different factions, you need to regain your freedom and control of your own destiny. Using diplomacy, cunning or combat, as well as help from allies you make, it's up to you to end one man's ambitions of conquest, which could spell the end for the continent and your island.

Experience the unique world of GreedFall again by exploring the old continent! Travel across new landscapes, from Olima – the city of stars of the Bridge Alliance – to the shores of Uxantis, and uncover the secrets of these ancient lands. Meet all the factions that share control over these nations and navigate the treacherous waters of their schemes and conspiracies.

Create your own character and find allies to join your team. Help them with their quests, uncover their secrets and make them your friends, rivals or even lovers. As well as equipping them the way you want, you can also take control of them in combat.

Immerse yourself in an ever deeper RPG experience where every choice has an impact on your adventure and where diplomacy, manipulation, infiltration and combat are all viable paths for you to achieve your aims.

Heroes of Science and Fiction.title: Heroes of Science and Fiction
Heroes of Science and Fiction.summary: A turn-based sci-fi strategy that combines exploration and exciting clashes on the battlefield. Take control over several different species, raise powerful armies for your heroes and destroy your opponents! This HoMM-like is set in a scifi universe, with new mechanics on top of the classic formula.

High Times (video game).title: High Times
High Times (video game).summary: Sit back and relax as you play the role of a donut therapist in this cozy dating/cooking sim. Feeling nervous? Need some happiness in your life? Here at High Times, there's a donut for every mood.

I Am Jesus Christ.title: I Am Jesus Christ
I Am Jesus Christ.summary: Walk in the footsteps of Jesus in this immersive first-person retelling of His life, from baptism to resurrection. Perform iconic miracles, meet biblical figures, and explore the Holy Land from Jerusalem to Galilee. Experience the story of the Messiah in I Am Jesus Christ.

Jay and Silent Bob: Chronic Blunt Punch.title: Jay and Silent Bob: Chronic Blunt Punch
Jay and Silent Bob: Chronic Blunt Punch.publisher: Interabang Entertainment, The MIX Games, Digital Eclipse
Jay and Silent Bob: Chronic Blunt Punch.summary:
Jump in the shoes of Lunch Box and Mr. Snoogans in a colorful Side-scrolling 2.5D over-the-top multiplayer brawler! Play as the dynamic duo alone or with a friend in a tag team combo fight fest. Destroy your enemies with fists, feet, and the magic of self-esteem destroying shit talk while you embark on a mission to find your long lost pot customers trapped in an Orwellian shopping center.

Jay and Silent Bob: Chronic Blunt Punch is a colorful side-scrolling tag-team beat-em-up where players swap back and forth between our heroes on the fly or perform special moves simultaneously with a friend. Our heroes embark on an epic adventure from the humble corners where they ply their trade to the gates of hell itself.

Little Nightmares VR: Altered Echoes.title: Little Nightmares VR: Altered Echoes
Little Nightmares VR: Altered Echoes.summary: Little Nightmares VR: Altered Echoes is a dark atmospheric adventurepuzzle game where you embody Dark Six, a mysterious figure with the shape of a little girl. Navigate in a disturbing world, solve intricate puzzles, and escape terrifying giant foes in a desperate search to become whole again.

Madden NFL 27.title: Madden NFL 27
Madden NFL 27.summary: Run the league one decision at a time in EA Sports Madden NFL 27, powered by the all-new Persona Engine.

Mole (video game).title: MOLE
Mole (video game).summary: Voices of the dead are calling you from deep below the earth. Pilot the Mole, a Soviet drilling vessel, in this PSX-style simulator-horror game set during the waning days of the cold war.

Mysplaced.title: Mysplaced
Mysplaced.summary: Mysplaced is an enchanting action-adventure game where exploration, puzzles, and combat come together in a beautifully crafted 3D world. Dive into a realm filled with secrets, challenges, and a compelling story waiting to be uncovered.

NASCAR 26.title: NASCAR 26
NASCAR 26.summary: The official game of NASCAR is back and better than ever with NASCAR 26! Battle your way through all four NASCAR National Series in Career, Quick Race, Championship, Multiplayer, or our all new mode featuring The Chase!

Needle In A Haystack Simulator.title: Needle in a Haystack Simulator
Needle In A Haystack Simulator.summary: The viral one. The one and only. Find 1 needle hidden amongst 5,000,000 pieces of hay.

Nighthawks (video game).title: Nighthawks
Nighthawks (video game).summary:
"Nighthawks is the brand new urban fantasy RPG from Wadjet Eye Games (The Blackwell Legacy, Unavowed, Technobabylon) and writer/designer Richard Cobbett (Sunless Sea/Sunless Skies, The Long Journey Home)."

"Nighthawks is a mix of story-driven RPG and undead life-simulation, where every decision you make is another move in your chess game against the world. Invest your time into learning new skills or honing your fighting style as you uncover the city's mysteries and venture deep into its darkest secrets. Gather fellow outcasts to your side, binding them with favours and choosing when to cash in. Manage your eternal thirst, legitimately, or balancing the risks of being caught stalking unwary victims and working the black markets."

No. 10: Full Confidence.title: No. 10: Full Confidence
No. 10: Full Confidence.summary: No. 10: Full Confidence is a political satire survival game, with you as British PM. Open your red ministerial box, decide which ridiculous crisis to fix, and keep Cabinet, Backbenchers, the Media, and the Public just barely on side.

Pathogenic (video game).title: Pathogenic
Pathogenic (video game).summary: You are a disease. Infect the human body as a lone pathogen in this cellular roguelike shooter. Collect organelles to evolve your parasite in a microscopic arms race against your host's immune system. Conquer a beautiful, procedurally generated world of tiny proportions.

Pictonico!.title: Pictonico!
Pictonico!.summary: Turn your photos into minigames! Sure, it's kind of silly... But there's no telling what will happen next!

Polylithic.title: Polylithic
Polylithic.summary: The Polylithic is a 3rd person crafting survival set in the Paleolithic/Neolithic era where the player crafts items, unlocks technology, discovers the world, builds bases, and can either grow the tribe and command the settlement or play the game solo.

Pool Room Billiard.title: Pool Room Billiard
Pool Room Billiard.summary: Enjoy moody gameplay with motion controls using two Joy-Con 2 controllers.A full-fledged 3D billiards game where you can battle players worldwide online!

Relooted.title: Relooted
Relooted.summary: Reclaim real African artifacts from Western museums in this Africanfuturist heist game. Recruit crew members, plan escape routes, acquire the precious cargo, and bounce out of the joint as fast as you can.

Retro Rewind.title: Retro Rewind: Video Store Simulator
Retro Rewind.summary: Manage your very own video store in the early 90s! Rent, sell, decorate and expand your business from the ground up and relive the golden ages of video rentals!

S&box.title: S&box
S&box.summary: S&box is a next-generation sandbox platform that lets players instantly play community-made games while creators build limitless experiences using a powerful modern engine. From rapid prototyping to full multiplayer games, everything lives in one connected ecosystem.

Samson (video game).title: Samson
Samson (video game).summary: Samson returns to Tyndalston, a city that shaped him hard, where every fight is close and every escape is earned. He owes dangerous people more than he can pay, and they’re using his sister to force his hand. The clock is running. The only way out is through anyone who stands in his way.

Scarlet Deer Inn.title: Scarlet Deer Inn
Scarlet Deer Inn.summary: An embroidered dark medieval folk tale. While life in a seemingly ordinary village is all about simple chores and idle gossip, sinister secrets hide below.

Scrap Mechanic.title: Scrap Mechanic
Scrap Mechanic.summary: Enter the creative paradise of Scrap Mechanic! Build fantastic machines, go on adventures with your friends and defend against waves of evil Farmbots in this imaginative multiplayer survival sandbox. With Scrap Mechanic’s powerful creation tools you can engineer your own adventures!

Scriptorium: Master of Manuscripts.title: Scriptorium: Master of Manuscripts
Scriptorium: Master of Manuscripts.summary: Run your manuscript workshop, receive orders to illustrate medieval books, decorate them any way you like, send them back to clients to get paid, and unlock new jobs, decorations, and items. Welcome to your very own medieval scriptorium!

Showa American Story.title: Showa American Story
Showa American Story.summary: Showa American Story is a brand new RPG and an enthusiastic love letter to the 80s' pop culture that features a strong taste of B-Movies. Follow Choko's journey of truth and revenge across North America as she grows stronger.

Skyblivion.title: Skyblivion
Skyblivion.summary:
Skyblivion is the ultimate fan-made experience for the Elder Scrolls IV: Oblivion, bringing the game into the newer engine of the Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim. This process combines Oblivion’s impressive award-winning open-world that is renowned for its incredible gameplay, memorable quests, and expansive world space with the advancements in gaming that have been made in the last two decades. Set in the Elder Scroll’s Third Era, during the cataclysmic Oblivion Crisis, you must help to restore the Imperial throne and repel the demonic Daedric invasion.

Skyblivion will feature the remastered entirety of Oblivion’s mainland, Cyrodiil, from the wintery slopes of the Valus and Jerall Mountains to the swamps of Blackwood and warm-beachy shores of the Gold Coast. Skyblivion will bring the return of many classic Oblivion mechanics like spell crafting, a complete class and attributes system, underwater combat, and NPC disposition.

In addition to recreating Oblivion’s systems and porting them into the Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim’s engine the project has taken great care in providing new improvements and additions. Skyblivion offers fans remastered graphics, weather, and lighting, an expanded soundtrack, new gameplay mechanics, and even a limited selection of bespoke minor quests with original voice acting to further flesh out barren areas of Oblivion—all for free!

Once Skyblivion is released in 2025, fans will have access to the entirety of Oblivion’s pre-DLC world space, systems, and quests available for play. But that’s not the end of the project! Following a period of bug-fixing and community-supported updates the project development team will move on to working on Oblivion’s nine additional content releases plus the Shivering Isles expansion.

With Skyblivion you experience the best of both worlds: The complex and detailed RPG experience of Oblivion paired with Skyrim’s newer systems, graphics, and quality of life improvements. Will you close shut the jaws of Oblivion once more in 2025?

Space Haven.title: Space Haven
Space Haven.summary: Embark on a space journey with your patched-together crew of civilians in search of a new home. Build spaceships tile by tile, create optimal gas conditions, manage the needs and moods of their crew, encounter other space-faring groups, and explore the universe in this spaceship colony sim.

Sunkissed City.title: Sunkissed City
Sunkissed City.summary: Sunkissed City is a life-sim set in an upbeat, sun-kissed seaside metropolis full of funky vibes and quirky characters. Stake out your new life in the city, tending to DIY gardens, learning new skills, and making life-long friends and help bring life back to its once-vibrant streets!

Super Battle Golf.title: Super Battle Golf
Super Battle Golf.summary: An online 1-8 player golf game where everyone plays at the same time. Swing, shoot, sabotage, and finish first by any means necessary in a free-for-all rush to the hole.

TANUKI: Pon's Summer.title: Tanuki: Pon's Summer
TANUKI: Pon's Summer.summary: The Tanuki Festival is just a month away, and the shrine is in disrepair. Follow Pon, a well meaning, if a bit lazy Tanuki with a part-time job at the Post Office, as he works to restore the shrine before summer ends. Deliver packages, make friends, and get the shrine ready for the big festival!

TR-49.title: TR-49
TR-49.summary: Narrative deduction meets audio drama, from the creators of Heaven’s Vault, Overboard! and A Highland Song.

Terra Invicta.title: Terra Invicta
Terra Invicta.summary: From the creators of Long War, an alien invasion has fractured humanity into seven ideological factions each with a unique vision for the future. Lead your chosen faction to take control of Earth's nations, expand across the Solar System, and battle enemy fleets in tactical combat.

The Bus (video game).title: The Bus
The Bus (video game).summary: The Bus is the next generation of city bus driving simulation. Sell tickets and transport passengers with various buses on different lines across the German capital Berlin on a realistic scale of 1:1.

The Duskbloods.title: The Duskbloods
The Duskbloods.summary: An online multiplayer PvPvE game where players vie for supremacy among themselves and against challenging foes. Play as the "Bloodsworn"; a group that has transcended human strength thanks to their special blood, and throw yourself into a violent fray for "First Blood" as the twilight of humanity approaches. The moontears will flow for one and one alone.

The Incident at Galley House.title: The Incident at Galley House
The Incident at Galley House.summary: In 1936, something terrible happened at Galley House. Decades later, with a strange contraption that reveals echoes of the past, you must uncover the truth behind this grisly mystery.

The Scourge (video game).title: The Scourge
The Scourge (video game).summary: The Scourge game tells stories revolving around urban legends from the 1990s in Saigon, Vietnam. The male protagonist is trapped by past sins caused by his and his family's mistakes. Now, he must confront and overcome the consequences to find a path to redemption, and you are him.

Unhinged (video game).title: Unhinged
Unhinged (video game).summary: It’s a dark and stormy night, the power’s gone out in an apartment building, and it turns out one woman, Ava (voiced by Zoë Kravitz), isn’t nearly as alone as she thought she was. Unhinged, out now, is unlike anything you’ve seen (or played) before. It’s an immersive game experience that puts you in the center of a thriller-turned-horror story, and your phone, which you use as a controller, is your only lifeline to escape.

Viractal: Will You Trust Your Party?.title: Viractal: Will You Trust Your Party?
Viractal: Will You Trust Your Party?.summary: A strategic board game-style RPG where dice rolls guide your journey! Build your deck, explore changing maps, and face events shaped by your choices and luck. Play solo or online with friends—every adventure is a new experience!

Wikigacha.title: Wikigacha
Wikigacha.summary: A card-collecting game featuring over 6,000,000 random Wikipedia articles that you can collect and battle with. Higher quality articles become higher rarity cards.

Witchbrook.title: Witchbrook
Witchbrook.summary: Experience the thrills and pitfalls of school-life in Witchbrook! Discover a spellbinding isometric pixel art world full of charm and intrigue in this richly detailed magical school and town life simulator.

Xenonauts 2.title: Xenonauts 2
Xenonauts 2.summary: Wage a global war of resistance against an alien invasion. Command turn-based tactical battles, build a network of covert bases, directly control your fighter wings, and achieve strategic victory in a simulation of asymmetric warfare against a technologically superior foe.

Yerba Buena (video game).title: Yerba Buena
Yerba Buena (video game).summary: Dive into a surreal 1970s gameworld and save San Francisco from a sinister threat. Play as Barb, and use the Oscillator to capture and reapply the physical traits of objects to solve mind-bending environmental platforming puzzles.
